# distribution-god

> Repo-native AI strategist for Claude Code and OpenAI Codex. Point it at any repository and it writes STRATEGY.md — positioning, market and competitor research, a ranked distribution plan, a gap table, a moat roadmap, and a calibrated Bigness /25 and Moat /25 verdict with crux, falsifier, and kill criteria — plus a shareable strategy-card SVG. Its /close-gaps follow-up researches current trends, papers, and look-alike products for pragmatic, testable fixes to the report's weakest points and writes CLOSE-GAPS.md. MIT licensed. Current version: 0.3.0.

Install in Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add jananthan30/distribution-god` then `/plugin install distribution-god@distribution-god`, then run `/distribution-god` (full run, needs web access), `/close-gaps` (research fixes for the report's weakest points, needs web access), or `/gap-scan` (a quick local audit, no web research).

Install in Codex: `codex plugin marketplace add jananthan30/distribution-god` then `codex plugin add distribution-god@distribution-god`; start Codex with `codex --search` for live web research.
